name: GetFirstFreeRowOrColumnRowIndexNode
label: Get First Free Row or Column Row Index
description: Gets the first free row or column row index based on the search direction in an Excel worksheet.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: SearchDirection
fields.label: Search Direction
fields.description: Specifies whether to search for the first free row or the first free column.

fields.name: Column
fields.label: Column
fields.description: The column to search in when looking for the first free row.

fields.name: Row
fields.label: Row
fields.description: The row to search in when looking for the first free column.

fields.name: ResultIndex
fields.label: Result Index
fields.description: The index of the first free row or column.
